All the seats in a Panchayat is filled by direct election:
The electorate is named 'Gram Sabha'
The Chairperson of each Panchayat is elected according to the law
passed by a State:
Seats are reserved in Panchayat for Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled
Tribes in proportion to their population [Art: 243D]:
Out of the reserved seats, 1/3 is reserved for women belonging
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes 1/3 of the total seats to be
filled by direct election in every Panchayat is reserved for women.
A State can make similar reservation for Chairpersons in the Panchayats_
Every Panchayat can continue for 5 years from the date of its first
meeting: It can be dissolved earlier in accordance with State law:
Panchayat reconstituted after premature dissolution, continues only
for the remainder of the period. But if the remainder of the period is
less than 6 months it is not necessary to hold elections_
All persons above 21 years of age and qualified to be a member of the
State Legislature are qualified as a member of a Panchayat [Art. 243F]:
